@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+package mime
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"io/fs"
+	stdmime "mime"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/conf"
+	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/resources"
+	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
+)
+
+var LosslessFormats []string
+
+type configuration struct {
+	Types    map[string]string `yaml:"types"`
+	Lossless []string          `yaml:"lossless"`
+}
+
+func load(fsys fs.FS) error {
+	data, err := fs.ReadFile(fsys, "mime_types.yaml")
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	var config configuration
+	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(data, &config); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if config.Types == nil || config.Lossless == nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("mime_types.yaml must define types and lossless")
+	}
+	for ext, typ := range config.Types {
+		if err := stdmime.AddExtensionType(ext, typ); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("register MIME type %q: %w", ext, err)
+		}
+	}
+
+	formats := make([]string, 0, len(config.Lossless))
+	for _, ext := range config.Lossless {
+		formats = append(formats, strings.TrimPrefix(ext, "."))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(formats)
+	LosslessFormats = formats
+
+	// Windows may associate JavaScript with text/plain.
+	if err := stdmime.AddExtensionType(".js", "text/javascript"); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return stdmime.AddExtensionType(".css", "text/css")
+}
+
+func init() {
+	conf.AddHook(func() {
+		if err := load(resources.FS()); err != nil {
+			panic(fmt.Errorf("load MIME configuration: %w", err))
+		}
+	})
+}
diff --git a/mime/mime_test.go b/mime/mime_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2503f69
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mime/mime_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+package mime
+
+import (
+	stdmime "mime"
+	"reflect"
+	"testing"
+	"testing/fstest"
+
+	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/resources"
+)
+
+func TestLoad(t *testing.T) {
+	previous := LosslessFormats
+	t.Cleanup(func() { LosslessFormats = previous })
+
+	fsys := fstest.MapFS{
+		"mime_types.yaml": &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("types:\n  .ndtest: audio/x-ndtest\nlossless:\n  - .ndtest\n  - .flac\n")},
+	}
+	if err := load(fsys); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if got := stdmime.TypeByExtension(".ndtest"); got != "audio/x-ndtest" {
+		t.Errorf("custom MIME type = %q", got)
+	}
+	if want := []string{"flac", "ndtest"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(LosslessFormats, want) {
+		t.Errorf("lossless formats = %v, want %v", LosslessFormats, want)
+	}
+	for ext, want := range map[string]string{".js": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8", ".css": "text/css; charset=utf-8"} {
+		if got := stdmime.TypeByExtension(ext); got != want {
+			t.Errorf("MIME type for %s = %q, want %q", ext, got, want)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestDefaultConfiguration(t *testing.T) {
+	if err := load(resources.FS()); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if got := stdmime.TypeByExtension(".flac"); got != "audio/flac" {
+		t.Errorf("FLAC MIME type = %q", got)
+	}
+	if len(LosslessFormats) != 9 {
+		t.Errorf("lossless formats = %v", LosslessFormats)
+	}
+}
